shared_visual_check: 逐张使用view_image检视：同一参考女性、黑色马尾、白色短袖、深灰长裤、灰蓝背景、柔和写实棚拍；无文字编号箭头；头部完整手足和支撑接触可见；1536×1024横向构图，同组机位尺度一致。
review_boundary: 图片核对仅记录可见姿势及接触，不证明肌肉发力、真实负荷或家具实际机械固定。083/084提示词明确要求凳靠墙固定，画面呈墙边稳定低凳，后侧与墙的接触被透视及凳体部分遮挡，不能由图片证明固定装置。

images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE independent photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, no collage. These three supplied images are visual identity references: preserve exactly the same adult East Asian woman, facial appearance, natural proportions, black ponytail, plain white short sleeve shirt and dark charcoal gray long trousers. Soft studio lighting, plain gray-blue studio wall and floor, realistic subtle shadows. Wide horizontal side-on full-body composition with head at left and feet toward right; retain all fingers, feet and support contacts, leave modest blank background, no text, numbers, arrows, logos or watermark. Exercise 082 T-LOW-029, step 01, side-lying LOWER leg hip adduction preparation. She lies on her LEFT side on a blue-gray non-slip exercise mat. Head and neck rest on a small white pillow, left arm relaxed under/near pillow, right palm rests on mat in front of torso. LEFT LOWER leg is straight and fully resting on the mat from hip to foot, clearly visible for its entire length. RIGHT UPPER leg is bent at hip and knee and placed FORWARD of the lower leg, with right sole planted firmly on mat in front of the left thigh/knee, without pinning or pressing the straight lower leg. Pelvis stacked and torso lies on its side without rolling. Both legs belong anatomically to the same woman; no floating feet. This is the low/start position, do not lift either leg.

images.prompt: Correct the exercise setup in Image 1 while preserving this same reference woman, face, black ponytail, white short-sleeve shirt, dark gray pants, gray-blue background, low left hip on mat, left forearm and lower left leg support, studio photo styling and horizontal full-body framing. Images 2-4 preserve exact visual identity. The required pose is SHORT LEVER Copenhagen support with a BENT upper knee. Crucial correction: move the small padded stool inward underneath the UPPER RIGHT KNEE region and proximal right shin, NOT under right ankle. Fully BEND upper right knee to approximately 90 degrees so a clear anatomical bend is visible. Right thigh reaches the stool; right knee and inner proximal shin, just below knee and away from joint line, rest on broad thick soft pad. Right lower leg folds backwards away from viewer toward the gray-blue wall; ankle and bare foot extend freely beyond back edge of cushion, NOT touching stool, not straight in line with thigh. Use a slightly elevated side-frontal camera if necessary to show this 90-degree upper knee bend, free upper foot and proximal shin support distinctly. Do not shorten shin unnaturally. LOWER LEFT knee and left foot stay firmly contacting mat, hip low. Full body including both feet and support contacts. One independent photorealistic image only, no words, arrows or collage.

discarded_attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. ONE photorealistic rehabilitation photo, exercise 083 T-LOW-030 step 01: SHORT-LEVER assisted Copenhagen adduction support setup. Input images 1-3 are identity and style references; preserve the same adult East Asian woman, black ponytail, plain white short sleeve shirt, dark charcoal long pants, realistic natural body proportions. Plain gray-blue studio wall/floor, soft studio light. Horizontal full-body photo viewed from directly in front of the SIDE of her body, head at left, stool at right. Full head, both hands, both bare feet, mat and all contacts visible. A stable low four-leg exercise stool with a dark cushioned top is at the right, anchored against the studio wall. Woman is on her LEFT side: LEFT forearm on gray-blue mat with left elbow directly below shoulder, left palm flat. UPPER RIGHT knee is bent around 90 degrees; ONLY the broad INNER PROXIMAL RIGHT SHIN immediately below knee rests across a thick soft pad on the stool. Pad contacts fleshy proximal shin, not knee joint line. Bent upper right lower leg folds backward beyond stool, with right ankle and foot free, visible, NOT weight-bearing on stool. LOWER LEFT leg remains bent on mat for assistance, left knee and left foot clearly touch mat. Pelvis is LOW, left hip still contacts mat, torso leaning sideways supported on left forearm. Right hand rests at right hip. This is preparation, not raised side plank. Make upper proximal-shin-to-pad contact and lower leg-to-ground contact anatomically clear. No ankle-supported straight upper leg, no floating lower leg, no extra limbs. No words, labels, numbers, arrows, watermark, collage.
